trap.label: stop somebody from
trap.wrong: The rain stopped us to go out.
trap.right: The rain stopped us from going out.
trap.why: O português "impediu-nos de sair" leva o aluno ao infinitivo. Em inglês: stop somebody from + -ing.

opts: I can't stop to think about it.

I can't stop thinking about it.

mcq.why: stop to do = para fazer algo.
stop to do = parar para fazer.

fix.wrong: We stopped to eat at midnight because we were full.
fix.right: We stopped eating at midnight because we were full.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The rain prevented us from walking.” com stop
rewrite.answer: The rain stopped us from walking.
